operations.name: read_vram_size
operations.desc: Read VRAM size from VGA memory configuration
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca00000]
and eax, 0xFF
shl eax, 20
ret

operations.name: read_framebuffer_offset
operations.desc: Read current framebuffer base offset in VRAM
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca00004]
and eax, 0xFFFFFF00
ret

operations.name: read_display_width
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca00008]
and eax, 0xFFFF
ret

operations.name: read_display_height
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca0000C]
and eax, 0xFFFF
ret

operations.name: read_color_depth
operations.desc: Read color depth bits per pixel
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca00010]
and eax, 0xFF
ret

operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read device status and capabilities flags
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, [0xfca00014]
and eax, 0x000F
ret
